rules.rationale: Each Java recipe needs IR strategy, acquisition closure, and machine semantics review.
Java advancement triggers need a Bedrock achievement, guide, or explicit equivalent decision.
Drops must participate in the survival acquisition graph and preserve relevant conditions.
Tag membership controls recipes and runtime predicates and needs a Bedrock projection decision.
Java fixtures require a Bedrock test-world equivalent or a documented platform-only replacement.
Source models, textures, sounds, particles, and UI assets need a visible Bedrock resource projection.
Generated Java assets require reproducible Bedrock resource output or an explicit equivalent.
Every Ponder scene needs a Bedrock tutorial interaction, guide page, or documented replacement.
Java-only integrations require an explicit native substitute, optional pack, or non-applicable decision.
Each Java behavior test needs a Node contract test, Bedrock test world scenario, or platform evidence plan.
